'''Garnac''' was a [[Trandoshan]] [[Gender|male]] [[big game hunter]] who ran a [[Garnac's hunting guild|hunting guild]] comprised of other Trandoshans, including his son [[Dar]]. Specializing conductions of hunts on the [[moon]] [[Wasskah]], Garnac's guild would kidnap other [[Sentience|sentient]] beings and bring them to one of Wasskah's [[Island Four|islands]], where they would be released and mercilessly hunted by the Trandoshans.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Time to see who's smart enough to join the hunt. Open fire!|Garnac|audio=Garnac-Openfire.flac|<ref name="PL" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars]], in [[20 BBY]],<ref name="Date20">{{TCWcanondates|322|the Garnac's defeat}}</ref> one of the guild members, [[Lo-Taren]], captured the [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] and brought her to the [[Trandoshan]] [[moon]] [[Wasskah]]. There, Garnac and his [[Garnac's hunting guild|guild]] hunted Tano and other prisoners, including three [[Jedi Initiate|younglings]]; [[Kalifa]], [[Jinx]] and [[O-Mer]]. Garnac had a son, [[Dar]], who had never killed a Jedi before and a chance would come when Dar was on a hunting trip with the rest of the Trandoshan hunters after his initiation, but things didn't go as planned. Kalifa [[Force push]]ed Dar off the vines and he fell to his death. By then, Garnac had successfully tracked Tano and Kalifa through the brush. Upon witnessing his son's demise, Garnac shot Kalifa in a fit of anger with a [[sniper rifle]], killing the previously captured youngling. He shouted at Tano, vowing for revenge against the "Jedi whelps" for killing his son. He yelled that there was no escape for Tano and her comrades and he would hunt them down.<ref name="PL" />

Later, Ahsoka and her companions teamed up with the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] who had been on the Trandoshan [[dropship]], a [[HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class Reugeot 905 freighter|HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class Reugeot 905]] hunted down following the terrible crash of the Trandoshan prisoner dropship killing the flexible but thickish, humiliating Trandoshan pilots [[Clutch]] and [[Goron]] done by Tano and the Jedi younglings, resulting as a failed attempt in escaping the confinable [[Island Four|hunting island]] of Wasskah. The next morning, Garnac and his forces investigated the destruction and he determined the younglings were organized, bold and Chewbacca was with them.<ref name="WH">{{TCW|Wookiee Hunt}}</ref>

The three young Jedi and their new friend managed to hijack a [[MSP80 Pteropter hover pod|Trandoshan hunting speeder]] after kidnapping the Trandoshan [[Smug]], whom they [[mind trick]]ed into needing his friend [[Krix]] to get them and flew up and [[Battle on Wasskah|attacked]] the Trandoshans' base of operation, an [[Ubrikkian floating fortress]]. Garnac and a two of his subordinates ran out of the trophy room. Garnac yelled to his troops that he wanted them to kill the younglings and he wanted their skins. In response to O-Mer firing the hijacked hover pod's rotary blaster on two of Garnac's troops, Garnac fired a rotary [[repeating blaster cannon]] attached to the exterior of the upper deck at O-Mer as the youngling flew around the perimeter of the lower deck, resulting in the pod landing into the lower deck. He told the younglings they had a valiant effort, especially Tano, whom he referred as "[[Togruta]]." He boasted she would be a prized trophy in his collection.<ref name="WH" />

However, Wookiee reinforcements led by [[General]] [[Tarfful]] arrived a moment later on the [[Zabrak]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Sugi (bounty hunter)|Sugi's]] ship, the ''[[Halo]]''. They had received a [[distress beacon]] via a [[transmitter]] constructed by Chewbacca. While the fight raged on and the Wookiees started to get the upper hand, Garnac ran inside the trophy room, followed by Tano. After a violent struggle between the two amidst the ensuing chaos, in which he used brute strength, hand-to-hand combats, an [[Trandoshan axe|axe]], a [[knife]] and a [[Trandoshan blaster]] to try and kill Tano, she eventually won and declared Garnac beaten. Garnac reiterated Tano would pay for the murder of his son. She replied Dar died because of his own actions, not hers. Garnac then turned and reached for the blaster. Tano warned him to not grab it, but he reached for it anyway, prompting Tano to Force push him out of the trophy room, sending him flying through the doors, over the railing and down to the lower deck.<ref name="WH" /> Despite the large fall, Garnac managed to survive.<ref name="Faster">{{TBB|Faster}}</ref><ref name="Getty">{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess/#!asset/36pf3knm8ptnv5br4hmzgtnn|text=ABB-004702|date=2023-01-18}}</ref>

Between [[19 BBY]] and [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|204}}</ref> following the [[Proclamation of the New Order|reformation]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] into the [[Galactic Empire]], Garnac was present on the planet [[Serolonis]]. There, he associated with [[Grini Millegi]], a [[Dowutin]] gangster sponsoring the [[Nosaurian]] [[Riot Racing|riot racer]] [[Jet Venim]] in the [[Safa Toma Classic]].<ref name="Faster" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Garnac-SWE.png|thumb|right|200px|Garnac, Trandoshan trophy hunter]]
Garnac was a Trandoshan male<ref name="DB" /> who stood at 2.1 [[meter]]s, or 6 [[Foot|feet]], 11 inches,<ref name="Join the Battle">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]''</ref> had [[Color|orange]] eyes and gray skin with green and yellow markings. He was ferocious,<ref name="DB" /> evil,<ref name="Join the Battle" /> thuggish, ruthless and a bloodthirsty individual who led a Trandoshan hunting party that captured and hunted people down for sport on [[Trandosha]]'s moon Wasskah. He liked nothing more than violence, strong confrontation combatants and was ghastly and intent through hunting down trophies and antiques such as mounted animal heads and creatures.<ref name="PL" /> He savored the longing thrill of stalking prey through the underbrush of Wasskah.<ref name="DB" /> What Garnac really seemed to care for was his son, Dar, whom he cherished greatly.<ref name="PL" /> He proudly watched Dar take up the hunt,<ref name="DB" /> pursuing after the Padawan Kalifa. However, Garnac had not counted on the resilience of their Padawan quarry, who had Force Pushed Dar to his death. Dar's death left Garnac in an angered frenzy and he became obsessed with revenge on the Jedi younglings and killed Kalifa with his sniper rifle.<ref name="PL" /> However, his vow for revenge was his undoing as he was focused on revenge, it backfired on him and caused his defeat at Ahsoka Tano's hands.<ref name="WH" />

==Skills and abilities==
As the leader of his hunting party, Garnac was an experienced hunter and a skilled fighter who was seen using a variety, including a knife, a Trandoshan axe, a sniper rifle, a [[Trandoshan blaster]] and [[blaster pistol]].<ref name="WH" /> His skills as a hunter were evident by the many trophies found adorning the walls of his guild, including [[Wampa]]s, Wookiees and [[Rancor]]s along with numerous other lethal beasts.<ref name="PL" /> Garnac was skilled in hand-to-hand combats as shown in his terrible ensuing fight with Ahsoka Tano.<ref name="WH" /> He also was an experienced tracker and sharpshooter and was known for his survival skills.<ref name="Join the Battle" />

==Behind the scenes==
Garnac first appeared in "[[Padawan Lost]]," the twenty first episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|season 3]], and was voiced by [[Zach Hanks]].<ref name="PL" />

A Trandoshan character with a similar model to Garnac appeared in "[[Faster]],"<ref name="Faster" /> the fourth episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''{{'s}} [[The Bad Batch Season 2|second season]], which aired on [[January 18]], [[2023]].<ref name="BB S2">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-bad-batch-season-2-trailer-key-art|text=Clone Force 99 Is Back in New ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 2 Trailer}}</ref> While never specified to be him in the episode,<ref name="Faster" /> an official promotional asset linked to the show released by [[The Walt Disney Company|Walt Disney Studios]] via [[Wikipedia:Getty Images|Getty Images]] on the same day confirmed the Trandoshan to be Garnac in the caption of the asset.<ref name="Getty" /> This, however, conflicts with ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'', which states Garnac was killed by Ahsoka Tano<ref name="Join the Battle" /> in the ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' episode "[[Wookiee Hunt]]."<ref name="WH" />
